highlights: Get up to 15% cashback on a spend category of your choice (dining, shopping, travel, wellness, transport, or entertainment), capped at S$250 per quarter. All other local eligible spend earns unlimited 1% cashback and all foreign eligible spend earns 0.5% cashback.

pros: One credit card, multiple ways to earn. You choose: 3% Stockback, 1.3 miles per dollar, up to 1.5% unlimited cashback or up to 15% bonus cashback. See 
Trust Freedom Card Key Facts Sheet
 for more details.
